Recovered funds must enter Phase 3 accounting, tax, allocation and payout controls.
AI training, output and synthetic-voice claims remain a separate evidence and legal workflow.
All migrations are additive with RLS, restricted storage, audit events, feature flags, kill switches and compensating rollback.
Every external action is idempotent, signed where applicable, replay-protected, versioned and reconciled.
Every task requires implementation and test evidence before completion.
